rca_of_the_issue.bug: CreateCustomCoursePage redirects to /courses after AI features confirmation
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Race condition between React state updates. In AIFeaturesGridModal.js handleConfirm(), onComplete() is called which triggers setStep(1) in parent, then onClose() is called. The onClose handler checks if step===0 to navigate to /courses. Due to React's async state batching, step is still 0 when onClose runs.
reproduction_steps: 2. AI Features Selection Canvas modal opens
5. Expected: Modal closes, page shows creation methods (step 1)
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Option 1: In AIFeaturesGridModal.js, don't call onClose() after onComplete() - let parent handle closing. Option 2: In CreateCustomCoursePage.js, use a ref to track if completion happened. Option 3: Pass a flag to onClose indicating successful completion.
